cands.name: Kenneth Paschal

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 73 since July 2021, elected in a special election. Retired U.S. Army first sergeant after 21 years of service. Previously worked in nonprofit roles, including governmental affairs director of the Alabama Family Rights Association.
cands.gaps: No sponsored-bill details, stated positions or campaign statements were found on data centers, homestead taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, guns, abortion, policing or schools. His birthplace, where he grew up and when he moved to Alabama are not stated in the sources. Ballotpedia says he did not complete its candidate survey, and it lists no endorsements for 2026. His sponsored-bill table was empty in the page text. Wikipedia notes he campaigned against critical race theory, but that is not tied to any specific policy position.

qual.background: Alabama House member since July 2021 (re-elected 2022 and 2026); 21-year U.S. Army veteran retired as first sergeant; governmental affairs director at the Alabama Family Rights Association; nonprofit founder and executive.
qual.why: Several years of actual legislative service writing law and the budget, plus governmental affairs work, put him in the high band. Committee seats and the vice-chair post were not counted.
